about: The model studio (pc/src/studio.cpp): the stage, the camera and the looks. Every number here is data; RPC studio {action: look, set: path, value} changes one, {save: true} keeps the whole file as the user's overlay (pc/user/studio/studio.json, ROOD_STUDIO), which is merged over this one.

camera.about_yaw: degrees from the model's front (0: face on, 180: from behind), added to its facing; weapons use weapon_yaw: the flat of the blade to the camera

turntable.about: Automatic rotation, either or both. model: the model itself turns (the light moves across its surface); light: the key light's yaw goes round the model. Degrees a second, negative the other way. paused holds the angles; fixed_dt (seconds, 0: real time) gives each render a fixed step, for tests.

backdrop.about: stage: the stage; solid: no stage (no floor, wall or drop shadow), the model on one colour (r, g, b 0..255) drawn as the game's own background, not lit.

neutral.about: A key light and a flat sky: the model read in clean light. The room's own lights, glows, haze and fog are off.

flat.about: Ambient light only, from every side alike: the model's colour with no shading to read it by.
